name: private-branch-pilot
notes: Draft solo pilot parameters, not adoption. App15368 was observed as GitHub Actions on existing GES main; verify on the new target before activation. Zero native reviewer count avoids a nonexistent second human; accountable review remains separate. SUCCESS-only is deliberately stricter than GitHub accepted skipped/neutral conclusions; successful conditional skips still require workflow review. Private merge queue is excluded because organization-owned Enterprise Cloud eligibility is not established.
